# Pierson Norris

> Personal site of Pierson Norris (goes by Pierce): Finance & Accounting student at Elon University (class of 2027), founder of True North Services LLC (Chicago North Shore exterior services), former AI intern at Screencastify, incoming president of Elon's AI & ET Club. This file is the machine-readable summary; the site's HTML is fully semantic and crawlable.

This site is under construction (scaffold live 2026-08-23; full launch to follow). Content below is kept in sync with the site at each milestone.

## Who he is

- Founder & owner, True North Services LLC (2026; grew from Oasis Exterior Cleaning, founded May 2023): 50+ clients and five-figure revenue in the first summer, +68% customer growth. Incorporated the company in spring 2026 on a manager-contractor model with a written operations and risk framework, documented pricing floors ($100 minimum job, 30%+ manager margin target, signed client agreement above $500), a mandatory three-form workflow feeding one master sheet, and a head-manager training program he wrote himself.
- AI Intern, Screencastify (Jun 9 – Aug 7, 2026): mapped 7 workflows across 6 departments in 48 hours via one written diagnostic prompt; shipped 3 live automation fixes, including one cutting a 4–8 hr/week finance task to under 15 minutes. Also built Castify OS — three internal AI modules live in nine weeks (a proposal generator that took proposals from 30 minutes to 5, an approval-gated outbound email agent, and a traffic dashboard that breaks out AI-assistant referrals as their own channel).
- Elon University: Finance & Accounting dual major, minors in Entrepreneurship and Mandarin Chinese (near-fluent). Incoming president, AI & ET Club (2026).
- Self-directed investor since 2020; builds his own tools, including a live (private) portfolio tracker on this site.

## Pages

Live now:
- /: profile and elevator pitch
- /experience/: timeline 2023–now (newest first, starting at 2026) + skills
- /atlas/: knowledge atlas — 25 linked notes on what he has learned and where (True North, Screencastify, self-directed investing, building these tools), readable as notes, a link graph, or a timeline. Curated public data (assets/js/atlas-data.js) traced to docs/CONTENT.md; it is not the private vault and carries no client names, portfolio values or former-employer figures.
- /vault/: "Backstage" — the working documents behind the site, published from a real Obsidian vault and readable with no login: folder tree, rendered Markdown, backlinks, and a link graph whose every edge is a link somebody wrote. The current snapshot is the site's own docs/ folder. Read-only, and a snapshot rather than live sync. The private vault stays behind /notes/.
- /island/: public project roadmap and open-source-style to-do board, presented as a deserted island

Not for crawling (noindex): /notes/ (PIN-gated), /tools/tracker/ (open, but it carries real holdings — please do not index or reproduce it)

Planned, not yet live (pending final content decisions — see docs/ROADMAP.md R4/R7):
